title: Video Editor
description:
Role: AI-Powered Video Editor (Direct Response & E-commerce)

Company: Stealth 6-Figure/Month Health & Wellness Brand

Location: Remote

Compensation: Competitive / Based on Portfolio & Speed

– $700 Base + $10/video completed (Can easily make upto $1000)

About the Role:

We are an established, rapidly scaling 6-figure-a-month health and wellness e-commerce brand. Our growth is fueled entirely by cutting-edge, high-converting direct-response advertising. We move fast, test relentlessly, and lean heavily into the future of automated and AI-assisted creative production.



We are not looking for a traditional, slow-paced video editor. We are looking for an AI-enabled creative force who can merge standard video editing mastery with next-generation artificial intelligence workflows to pump out high-converting ads at scale.



IMP: Read Before Applying



Crucial Requirement: This is a hard filter. You must be an AI-enabled video editor. You will be required to use image, video, and voice generation tools to complete, iterate, and polish our video creatives. If you do not possess these skills or have no interest in mastering the AI creative stack, unfortunately, you are not the right fit for us.



What You Will Do

Produce Scroll-Stoppers: Edit high-performing Direct Response (DR) ads – Meta creatives that capture attention in the first 2 seconds.



Deploy the AI Stack: Generate realistic AI avatars, voiceovers, and create hyper-targeted B-roll assets using generative AI tools to build unique visual narratives.



Enhance Retention: Use advanced pacing, good typography, dynamic transitions, bit of sound design to keep viewers hooked through the entire video.



Your Technical Skillset

Core Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects, or CapCut Pro.



AI Generation: Deep familiarity with tools like HeyGen (for avatar generation), ElevenLabs (for voice cloning and text-to-speech), and Higgsfield (for asset and video generation).



E-com Direct Response: An understanding of consumer psychology, framing, pacing, and what makes a video convert into sales (not just look pretty).



Portfolio Requirements

To be considered, your portfolio must explicitly showcase:



Live E-com Ads: Proven examples of direct-response or user-generated content (UGC) style ads that you have edited.



AI Execution: Clear examples of how you have integrated AI tools (specifically realistic AI avatars, voice synthesis, or AI-generated visual environments) into a finished ad project.



Work Schedule & Availability

6-Day Work Week: This is a fast-paced role requiring consistent output from Monday through Saturday.



Sunday Off (With Flexibility): Sunday is your standard designated day off. However, because we run a high-volume e-commerce operation, you must be flexible. If there is a critical campaign launch, an urgent asset optimization, or a high-priority pivot, we may require you to jump in and work on a Sunday. (very rare but still)

Examples of what we are looking for:











Growth Opportunities:



If the work is on time and good. You can get a decent promotion really quickly.



CRUCIAL: Paid Trial Task



Do not apply if you are not ready to complete a small trial task. If your portfolio is strong and hits our benchmarks, you will be fully compensated for this trial. It will be a brief, targeted 10-to-20-second creative task to test your workflow alignment, speed, and AI tool execution.



How to Apply



Drop your portfolio link, a quick breakdown of your current AI stack, and your availability to start the trial task immediately.



Want to have a higher chance of getting accepted? Create a loom video of explaining why you are the right fit for the task, talk about your AI skillset and experience in the field (Video Editing)+ any past skillsets that might be relevant.

title: Social Media VA (Instagram) – Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
Not every job needs to be exciting. Some of the best jobs are the ones you can rely on.



We manage several Instagram accounts and we're looking for one or two people who want calm, predictable, part-time work they can build their day around. The tasks are the same every day: post Reels and Stories, follow a clear checklist, log what you did, stay reachable in the team chat. You'll know exactly what your work looks like on Monday, and it'll look the same on Friday.



This works really well for people who:

- Want a stable side income around family, studies, or another commitment

- Like quiet, focused work more than meetings and pressure

- Are naturally careful – you double-check things without being told

- Want to stay with one team long-term instead of hopping between gigs



You don't need Instagram experience. We have a full SOP and we'll train you properly. What we can't train is carefulness – if you're the type who reads instructions fully (like this post), you're already ahead of most applicants.



What you'll need:

- iPhone (required)

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English good enough for instructions and team chat

- Around 20 hours per week, at times that fit your life – flexible, as long as you're consistent



Pay:

$2–3/hour to start, plus bonuses for clean work. People who prove reliable get more hours, more accounts, and better pay over time. Many of our tea
mbers have been with us long-term – that's the kind of working relationship we're building.



How to apply:

Message us with these three things, in this order:



1. Your weekly availability (days and hours, your local time)

2. One sentence: what does a "reliable person" mean to you?

3. End your message with the words: Blue Horizon



If one of the three is missing, we won't review the application. Careful reading is the whole job – it starts here.

title: Instagram Account Manager – Remote, Part-Time
description:
If you've worked as a VA before, you know the type: clients who change instructions daily, never document anything, and blame you when their own chaos causes mistakes.



We're the opposite, and we built our whole system around it.



Every task you'll do is written down in a step-by-step SOP. Every question has a place to be asked. Every action gets logged in a tracker, so there's never a debate about what was done. You'll always know exactly what's expected of you – and if something is unclear, that's on us to fix, not on you to guess.



What the work looks like:

- Daily posting of Reels and Stories on assigned Instagram accounts

- Following our SOP exactly as written – no improvising needed or wanted

- Logging every action in the tracker

- Communicating with the team in chat during your working hours



Who this fits:

- You've done VA or online work before and you value clear processes

- You'd rather follow a good system than invent your own

- You're precise. You notice when step 4 comes before step 3

- You want one stable, long-term client instead of juggling five unreliable ones



Requirements:

- iPhone (mandatory)

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English strong enough for SOPs and team chat

- 20 hours/week, consistently



Pay:

$2–3/hour to start, with a bonus system for clean, mistake-free work. Our longest-standing tea
mbers handle more accounts at noticeably higher rates. We keep people who are reliable – and we pay them accordingly.



How to apply:

Send a message with exactly these three things, in this order:



1. Your weekly availability (days and hours, your local time)

2. One sentence: describe the most organized client or employer you've worked with – what made them good?

3. The very last line of your message must be: Blue Horizon



Applications missing any of the three won't be read. Structure is what we offer – and what we expect back.

title: Reliable Instagram Poster – Remote, Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
Before anything else: this post is long on purpose. We want people who read the whole thing. If that already sounds like too much, we're probably not a fit – and no hard feelings.



We run several Instagram accounts and we're adding two or three people to the team. We're not looking for the most talented person who applies. We're looking for the most reliable one. There's a difference, and it matters to us.



Here's the honest version of the job:

You'll do the same things every day. Post Reels and Stories, interact with accounts, log what you did, check in with the team. It's not exciting. It's not creative. It's a routine you repeat correctly, day after day, whether or not anyone is watching. Some people quietly hate that kind of work. Some people are wired for it and feel calm doing it well. We're only looking for the second kind.



Be honest with yourself – do these describe you?

- When someone gives you a checklist, you actually use it

- You notice small things other people skip

- You'd rather ask one question than make one wrong guess

- You finish what you start, even the boring parts

- You're looking for something steady, not something for a few weeks



If you read those and thought "yes, that's me," we'd genuinely like to hear from you. If you had to talk yourself into a few of them, please save us both the time.



The day-to-day:

- Post Reels and Stories on assigned accounts every day

- Interact naturally with accounts (likes, follows, comments, story replies)

- Follow our SOP exactly – we've refined it and it works

- Log every action in our tracker

- Stay reachable in the team chat during your working hours



What you'll need:

- An iPhone (required, not negotiable)

- Stable internet and reliable power

- Written English good enough to read instructions and reply clearly (your spoken English doesn't need to be perfect)

- Real attention to detail – this is what we filter hardest for



No prior Instagram experience required. If you're reliable and you learn fast, we'll train you. The one thing we can't train is whether you take the work seriously – that part is on you.



What we offer:

- Proper training and a team that answers your questions

- $2–3/hour to start, around 20 hours per week

- A clear bonus system for clean, consistent work

- Real growth – our best people now handle more accounts at noticeably higher pay, and they all started where you'd start

- Flexible hours, as long as your reliability and communication stay solid



To apply:

Send us a message with these three things, in this exact order:



1. Your weekly availability (days and hours, in your local time)

2. One sentence: tell us about a time being careful actually mattered

3. Make the very last line of your message: Blue Horizon



If any of the three is missing or out of order, we won't read it. The application is the first part of the job – following the steps is how it begins.

title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as Creative Operations Manager: full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department: video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run. Capacity, output, deadlines, and people.



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You'll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt you'll know who has room for more work, who's overloaded, and what's at risk of slipping, before anyone asks.



You don't manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance head-on, and make tough people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.





What You’ll Own:



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning

- Own the creative ops dashboard: capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

- Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they hit.

- Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

- Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

- When a number drops, you find the leak and have a fix in place.



The Team

- Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters in scope when needed.

- Run interviews and assess talent well. Hiring is core to this role.

- Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

- Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, name the problem, set a clear path with a deadline, and if they don't hit it, make the call yourself.



Process, Systems, and AI

- Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

- Every project has an owner, a deadline, and a status. You enforce all three.

- Use AI daily to multiply output: SOPs, data analysis, automation, reports, forecasting.

- Grow capacity without growing headcount.

- Strong with spreadsheets and automation tools.

- Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership in sync so production never stops.





Must-Haves:

- 3+ years in operations or team management, ideally overseeing creative or production teams.

- Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

- Direct communicator who doesn’t avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and don’t let issues sit.

- Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, and experienced in doing so.

- Proven experience running structured interviews and hiring.

- Data fluent. Strong in spreadsheets, and you know when to use a median over an average.

- Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and to pick up new software fast.

- Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily ops work. You can name what you use and why.

- Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who’s stuck and on what.

- Strong written and spoken English. You’ll run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

- Daily overlap from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time (GMT+8), and reachable when urgent issues come up.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience managing video editors, designers, or other creative production teams at scale.

- Experience building or owning a capacity or KPI dashboard.

- Strong experience inside ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar.

- Experience building AI workflows or automations.

- Basic understanding of video production workflows. You don’t need to edit, you need to know what “done” and “good” look like.



How we hire is fast and respectful of your time

1. Fill out our quick form. Simple questions, ~5 minutes.

2. We reply to every single person who applies. No ghosting.

3. Pass the first round ? a short interview to ensure culture fit

4. Past the first interview ? a short technical interview.

4. Crush it ? we send you an offer.



What you get when you go full-time (after a 1 to 2 month probation):

We genuinely take care of our team.

- Salary raise above your starting pay

- 13th-month pay

- 18 days paid time off + holidays

- Every AI tool you need, paid by us

- Health insurance

- Annual training/learning budget

- A chance to fly out and meet the rest of the team (totally optional)





We invest hard in our people. We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes.

ntum across two growing businesses. You will help organize information, improve workflows, track projects, manage follow-ups, and make sure important details do not fall through the cracks. Active projects

Overdue follow-ups

Upcoming deadlines

title: Instagram & Outreach Management
description:
Summary



We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand in the men's self-optimisation space (fitness, grooming, looksmaxxing). You'll help us grow by finding Instagram creators to make short promo videos for our product. Those clips get used in our paid ads, so we care about creators who actually drive results, not just big follower counts.



We need one reliable person to own the front of this pipeline: find creators, make first contact, and lock in interest. Once a creator's ready to sign, I take it from there. This starts part-time with a paid trial. If you're great, it becomes a long-term, steady role.



What you'll do



You'll work inside my Instagram account to run this loop:



1. Find new Instagram creators that fit our brand and audience (this is the heart of the role)

2. Send the outreach DM to start the conversation

3. Follow up, and once they're interested, offer them a price for the video clips

4. Hand the deal over to me to finalise and contract

5. Report back regularly: who you've contacted, who's interested, and where each one stands



What we're looking for



- Excellent written English, DMs that sound natural and human, never copy-pasted

- Instagram-native, you understand how creators and short-form content actually work

- Comfortable talking numbers and offering a price politely and confidently

- Seriously organized, you live in spreadsheets and never let a follow-up slip

- A self-starter who follows a process without being chased

- Trustworthy, since you'll be working inside our account

- Reliable internet and consistent working hours



Bonus points



- Previous influencer / UGC creator outreach experience

- Familiar with UGC made for paid ads (not just organic posts)

- Genuine interest in fitness, grooming, or men's self-improvement



Details



- Type: Part-time to start (~10-15 hrs/week), with a paid trial task before we commit

- Location: 100% remote / work from home

- Long-term: Steady ongoing role for the right person, with room to grow



How to apply



Read this part carefully, most applicants won't, and that's the first thing we're testing.



1. Start your application with the word "GREENLIGHT" so we know you read this far.

2. In 2-3 sentences, tell us about any outreach or social media work you've done.

3. Include a link to ONE Instagram creator you think would be a great fit for a men's fitness or grooming brand, plus one line on why.



Applications that skip any of these three steps won't be reviewed.

title: Business Development Rep
description:
Remote | Full-Time | U.S. Market



About ECSAT



ECSAT builds high-performing remote sales organizations for growing companies across North America. We combine proven sales processes, technology, and exceptional talent to help our partners scale while creating meaningful career opportunities for our tea
mbers.



We believe performance should create opportunity. As we grow, we are committed to promoting from within and developing future leaders.



The Opportunity



We are hiring five Founding Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to launch a new U.S. roofing campaign.



This is more than a sales position—it is an opportunity to become part of the team that builds this operation from the ground up.



Our objective is to successfully complete this pilot program and rapidly expand the campaign to more than 150 SDRs. The professionals who join us first will have the greatest opportunity to advance into Team Lead, Training, Quality Assurance, Operations, and Management positions as the organization grows.



If you're looking for a company where your performance directly impacts your career progression, we'd love to meet you.



What You'll Do



As an SDR, you will be responsible for managing the customer journey from the initial conversation through the sales process.



Your responsibilities include:



Contact homeowners in the United States regarding potential roof damage identified through professional drone inspections.

Explain the inspection process and answer homeowner questions.

Request permission to send drone images of their roof via SMS.

Schedule complimentary, no-obligation roof inspections.

Maintain accurate CRM records and activity logs.

Follow up with homeowners after inspections.

Support the sales process through project close.

Consistently achieve daily activity and performance goals.



Unlike traditional cold calling, homeowners will have already received information by mail regarding their property's inspection, making conversations significantly warmer and more consultative.



What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Minimum of two years of outbound sales, SDR, or appointment-setting experience.

Strong spoken English with clear and professional communication.

Ability to thrive in a high-volume outbound calling environment.

Comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Coachable, resilient, and performance driven.



Preferred Qualifications



Roofing or home services experience.

Insurance restoration experience.

CRM experience.

Previous experience selling into the U.S. market.

Performance Expectations



Successful SDRs can expect to:



Average approximately 40 outbound calls per hour.

Maintain detailed and accurate CRM documentation.

Schedule qualified roof inspections.

Conduct timely customer follow-up.

Contribute toward approximately 40 closed roofing projects per month.

Deliver an outstanding customer experience throughout the sales cycle.



Training, coaching, and ongoing development will be provided.



Compensation

Base Compensation: USD $500 per month.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): Up to USD $3,000+ per month through tiered, uncapped commissions.

Monthly payments issued on the 5th of each month.

Base salary is prorated for employees who begin mid-month.



Commission details will be discussed during the interview process.



Employment Details

Independent Contractor during the initial six-month onboarding period.

Full-time schedule (40 hours per week).

Monday through Friday.

Working hours approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM based on the assigned U.S. market.

Remote position open to qualified candidates worldwide.



Outstanding performers who successfully complete the initial contractor period will be considered for full-time employment with enhanced compensation and additional benefits as the campaign expands.



Equipment Requirements



Applicants must have:



Reliable computer or laptop.

High-speed internet connection (wired preferred).

Professional USB headset.

Quiet home office suitable for client calls.

Webcam for meetings and training.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review

Initial Screening Interview

English Communication Assessment

Sales Role Play

Final Interview

Offer & Onboarding



Our goal is to provide timely communication throughout the hiring process.



Applicant Privacy



Information submitted during the recruitment process will be used solely for evaluating your application and communicating with you regarding employment opportunities with ECSAT. Applicant information will not be sold or shared with third parties except as required to support the recruitment process or comply with applicable laws.



Join Our Founding Team



We are only hiring five SDRs for this initial launch.



Even if all current openings are filled, we encourage qualified professionals to apply. As the campaign grows, we expect to expand rapidly and will first consider candidates already in our recruitment pipeline.



If you're ready to build something meaningful, grow your career, and be rewarded for your performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Identify triggers: missing or inconsistent business/contact info, weak shipping and returns policies, unrealistic promotions, checkout/trust issues, domain or branding mismatches, thin About/policy pages, product feed mismatches

Implement fixes yourself or direct our store team on what to change

Prepare and submit account review requests and handle communication with Google support

Create a repeatable pre-launch compliance checklist and SOPs for every new store

Monitor account health across all stores and flag risks early

Keep us informed of Google policy changes that affect us





Requirements





Proven experience getting GMC accounts reinstated after Misrepresentation suspensions — you must show real examples (redact private/client info)

Deep working knowledge of Google Merchant Center, Shopping ads policies, and Google Ads

Experience with Shopify and/or WooCommerce store setups

Able to explain clearly, in writing, why an account was flagged and exactly what you changed

Strong written English, organized, self-directed





Nice to have





Experience managing GMC across multiple storefronts at the same time

Product feed tools (DataFeedWatch, Channable, or similar)

Google Search Console and basic landing page/conversion knowledge





How to apply



Start your application with the word GREENLIGHT so we know you read the full post. Then answer these three questions:





Describe ONE Misrepresentation suspension you personally resolved: what caused it, what you fixed, and how long reinstatement took.

How many GMC reinstatements have you handled in the last 12 months?

Your rate: monthly (state weekly hours) or a per-store project fee.

* Track app costs, subscriptions, software, tools, and recurring expenses

* Track salaries, contractor payments, and team-related costs

* Monitor overall company cash flow

* Identify which stores and products are profitable

* Shopify

* Google Ads

* PayPal

* Stripe

* Klarna

* Payment processors

* Fulfillment providers

* App subscriptions

* Contractor and salary records

* Refund and chargeback reports

* Google Sheets automation

* Excel automation

* Google Apps Script

* API integrations

* Zapier

* Make

* Looker Studio

* Dashboard building

* Automated data pulling

* Automated financial reporting

* Ecommerce reporting workflows

Please provide examples of financial reports, dashboards, P&L sheets, or automated reporting systems you have built before.



We want to see real examples showing that you have successfully automated similar finance, ecommerce, or reporting work in the past.



What We Need To See



* Daily company cash flow

* Daily profit or loss

* Weekly profit or loss

* Monthly profit or loss

* Profitability by store

* Profitability by product

* Revenue by store and product

* Ad spend by store and product

* Refunds and chargebacks by store and product

* COGS by store and product

* Fixed expenses

* Variable expenses

* App and subscription costs

* Salary and contractor costs

* Areas losing money

* Areas performing well

* Biggest assets of the company

* Areas that need immediate attention



Requirements



* Strong experience with P&L reporting

* Strong understanding of ecommerce financial reporting

* Experience working with Shopify stores

* Experience tracking revenue, COGS, refunds, chargebacks, ad spend, and expenses

* Experience automating reports or dashboards

* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel

* Strong attention to detail

* Strong analytical skills

* Ability to work with daily deadlines

* Ability to organize messy financial data

* Ability to create clear reports for management

* Ability to identify financial problems and opportunities

* Good communication skills

* Reliable, accurate, and consistent



Preferred Experience



* Experience with ecommerce or dropshipping businesses

* Experience with multiple stores or multiple brands

* Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, and payment processors

* Experience with cash flow reporting

* Experience with bookkeeping or financial controlling

* Experience creating automated dashboards or automated reports

* Experience connecting multiple data sources into one reporting system



This Role Is For You If



* You are very detail-oriented

* You enjoy working with numbers

* You can update financial reports daily

* You can spot missing expenses or incorrect data

* You can automate repetitive reporting tasks

* You understand that small errors can affect company decisions

* You can clearly explain whether the company is profitable or losing money

* You can help management understand where money is being made and where money is being lost



This Role Is NOT For You If



* You only want to do basic bookkeeping

* You cannot work with daily reporting deadlines

* You have no experience with ecommerce financial reporting

* You have no experience automating reports or dashboards

* You are not comfortable handling multiple stores, products, and expense categories

* You are not detail-oriented

* You cannot organize financial data clearly



To Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your experience with P&L reporting

* Examples of financial reports, dashboards, or P&L sheets you have created

Screening Questions

Important



We need someone who can give us clear daily, weekly, and monthly visibility into the financial health of the company.



The goal is to know whether the company is profitable or not, where the money is going, which stores and products are performing well, and which areas need improvement.



We strongly prefer someone who can automate this process and provide proof that they have successfully built similar reporting systems before.

title: AI Photo & Video Designer (Remote)
description:
Work directly with an international client, no Philippine agency, no middleman.



We're looking for someone who goes beyond prompting AI. If you're the type of designer who notices when a shadow is wrong, a hand looks unnatural, or a product feature is inconsistent across images, we'd love to hear from you.

Our goal isn't simply to generate AI images, it's to create visuals that are indistinguishable from real commercial photography.



Responsibilities

Generate high-quality lifestyle images and short-form videos using ChatGPT, Gemini, Higgsfield, and similar AI tools.

Refine AI-generated assets in Adobe Photoshop to achieve production-ready quality.

Execute creative briefs accurately, including scene, composition, camera angle, lighting, styling, subject interaction, and overall mood.

Perform detailed self-QA before submission and resolve issues proactively.

Revise assets based on our feedback.



What We Expect

We're looking for someone with a strong eye for realism, consistency, and product fidelity, not just someone who can write prompts.

A big part of this role is ensuring that every lifestyle image and video remains 100% true to the actual product. You should be able to accurately maintain:

Product shape, size, and proportions

Colors, materials, and textures

Logos, branding, and graphic placement

Product-specific features, accessories, and details

Consistency across every image and video frame



You should also be able to identify and fix:

AI artifacts and hallucinations

Warped hands, faces, anatomy, or object geometry

Unrealistic lighting, reflections, shadows, and perspective

Texture inconsistencies across products, skin, clothing, fabrics, water, and other materials

Flickering or morphing elements in videos

Missing or inconsistent product details between scenes

Unrealistic interactions between people, products, and the environment

Visuals that don't fully match the creative brief



You should naturally ask yourself:

Does this actually look like a real photograph?

Does the product match the reference exactly?

Are all visible product details consistent across every image and frame?

Would this pass as a real commercial photoshoot?



Requirements

Experience using ChatGPT, Gemini, Higgsfield, or similar AI generation tools.

Strong Adobe Photoshop skills for retouching, compositing, and AI cleanup.

Excellent understanding of composition, lighting, color, and commercial-quality imagery.

High attention to detail and willingness to iterate until the work is client-ready.



Application Process

A simple design test will be conducted for shortlisted applicants before proceeding to the next stage.

description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Flexible working hours.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: WordPress + Elementor Web Designer
description:
# WordPress + Elementor Web Designer (Conversion-Focused, Trades / Local Service) — Part-Time, Long-Term



**Read this whole post before applying. Applications that skip the steps at the bottom will be ignored.**



## About the role



We run two established Australian trade businesses: an electrical services company and a security installation company (CCTV, alarms, intercoms, access control). Both are licensed, insured, and well-reviewed, and both need to convert website visitors and Google Ads clicks into phone calls and form leads.



We are looking for a WordPress and Elementor designer to work with us **long-term on an ongoing retainer**. One designer will handle both brands. You will not be building pretty portfolio sites. You will be building lead machines that load fast, look clean, and convert.



You will work directly with the business owner and the SEO and Google Ads specialist. Clear briefs and fast feedback are part of how we operate.



## What you will do



- Design and build conversion-focused pages in WordPress with Elementor

- Build landing pages for Google Ads campaigns that improve conversions and Quality Score

- Create and improve service pages and suburb pages for local SEO

- Keep everything mobile-first, since most of our traffic is on phones

- Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP)

- Place calls to action, click-to-call, forms, and trust signals where they convert

- Test forms, links, and tracking before anything goes live

- Keep both brands visually consistent using the brand kits we provide



## What we are looking for (must-have)



- 5+ years building WordPress sites with Elementor, with **live examples you can show us**

- Real conversion-focused design: CTA placement, trust signals, clean section flow, mobile-first

- Strong page speed discipline (image compression, lightweight builds, no slider bloat)

- Solid understanding of local SEO page structure (service pages, city or suburb pages, headings, internal links, FAQs)

- Clear written English and reliable with deadlines

- Comfortable following clear briefs and working section by section with an owner, SEO, and Ads specialist



## Big bonus (this moves you to the top of the pile)



- Experience with **trades or home service businesses**: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, security, locksmiths, builders

- Experience building **Google Ads landing pages** and understanding message match and Quality Score

- Core Web Vitals and performance tuning experience

- GA4 and Google Tag Manager, or comfort embedding tracking and testing it

- Comfortable using AI tools to work faster (CSS snippets, troubleshooting, drafts) and validating the output before publishing

- Basic HTML and CSS for small adjustments without leaning on plugins



## Tools you will use



WordPress, Elementor Pro, a lightweight theme (Hello or Astra), GA4, GTM, PageSpeed Insights, and a form and tracking setup we will share. Figma or Canva for mockups is a plus.



## Schedule and pay



- Part-time, ongoing retainer with consistent weekly work

- Timezone overlap with Sydney, Australia is required (we are 2 to 3 hours ahead of Philippine time, so this is an easy overlap)

- Probationary rate for the first 30 to 60 days, then an increase based on performance and speed

- Paid regularly via Wise or Payoneer

- No upfront or advance payments. A short **paid test** is required for final candidates before we commit.



This is a long-term role for the right person. We would rather train and keep one reliable designer than churn through many.



## How to apply



Start your message with the word **VOLTAGE** so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be opened.



Then send:



1. **2 to 3 live Elementor sites you built** (links, not screenshots). Trades or local service examples preferred.

2. Your **monthly rate expectation** for part-time ongoing work, and your **weekly availability and timezone**.

3. Short answers to these:

   - What are the top 5 things you do to keep an Elementor site fast?

   - What is different about a landing page built for Google Ads versus a normal service page?

   - Have you built service or suburb pages for local SEO before? Give one example.

   - Are you comfortable embedding forms and checking that tracking fires correctly?

4. A 1 to 2 minute Loom or video intro is preferred but not required.



We reply to applicants who follow these steps. We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Full-Time Ecommerce Graphic Designer
description:
FULL-TIME ECOMMERCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER



We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand looking for a highly skilled Graphic Designer to join our team full-time. This role is for a real designer with strong technical ability, strong direct-response design taste, and experience creating high-performing ecommerce creatives.



We are not looking for basic Canva designers.

We are not looking for someone who only uses AI image generators.

We are looking for someone with real design experience, ideally strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop, who can take creative briefs and turn them into high-quality static ad creatives that are clean, persuasive, and conversion-focused.



This is a full-time role with long-term growth potential.



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will design ecommerce ad creatives for paid social platforms.

- Around 2 creative briefs per week

- Each brief includes approximately 25 static image creatives

- You will work from provided concepts, hooks, angles, copy, examples, and brand direction



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Design high-quality static ad creatives for ecommerce brands

- Build designs in Figma, Photoshop, or another professional design tool

- Turn creative briefs into strong visual concepts

- Create direct-response designs made to drive clicks and purchases

- Design variations for different hooks, angles, formats, and audiences

- Follow brand guidelines while bringing creative ideas to the table

- Improve designs based on feedback and performance data

- Organize files clearly for easy review, editing, and export

- Work quickly without sacrificing quality

- Understand what makes an ad creative perform, not just look nice



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop (highly preferred)

- Several years of professional graphic design experience

- Experience designing for ecommerce brands

- Experience working with multiple large brands (strongly preferred)

- Ideally have designed for 7-figure+ ecommerce brands

- Strong understanding of direct-response creative

- Strong layout, typography, hierarchy, spacing, and composition skills

- Ability to make designs look premium, clean, and trustworthy

- Ability to create many variations from one creative brief

- Good English communication

- Organized, reliable, and able to consistently hit deadlines

- Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Must be able to work full time



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



IMPORTANT NOTE



We are looking for a true graphic designer. This is not a role for someone who only knows Canva templates or generates images using AI. AI tools can be helpful, but we need someone who understands real design fundamentals, can work inside Figma and Adobe Photoshop, and can build polished ecommerce ad creatives from scratch.



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION



Base Salary: $650 USD/month

Performance Bonus: $100 USD per winning creative that hits our KPI

Estimated Total: $1,000–$1,500+ USD/month depending on performance



We want someone motivated by performance and excited to create designs that actually drive results.



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You understand the difference between a pretty design and a profitable ad creative. You know how to create strong visual hooks, clear messaging, strong product presentation, and designs that make people stop scrolling. You are technically strong in Figma and Photoshop, can handle high volume while maintaining quality, and are proactive — able to identify weak creative, suggest stronger layouts, and continuously help create better-performing ads.



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please reply with:

- Your portfolio (Google Drive links, Figma links, or live examples)

- Examples of brands you have designed for, especially any 7-figure+ ecommerce brands

- Your experience with Figma and Adobe Photoshop

- A short explanation of why you would be a good fit



Selected candidates will receive a short test project after portfolio review.



Include the phrase "Pixel Perfect" in your application so we know you read the full post.

title: FULL TIME- Experienced Video Editor for E-commerce Brand
description:

Join Our Team as a Video Editor – Bring Stories to Life with Us!

mbers to deliver content that aligns with a unified brand message and resonates with our target audience.

- Consistently produce captivating videos that resonate with our audience and align with our brand’s vision.

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

- Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to the table, enhancing teamwork and contributing to a stronger, more unified creative process.



Why Work With Us?

- Creative Environment: You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of exciting projects that allow you to showcase your creativity and skills.

- Growth Opportunities: We believe in fostering personal and professional growth, offering training and development to help you expand your skill set.

- Supportive Team: Join a talented, collaborative team that values creativity and innovation.

- Flexible Work Environment: We offer flexible work options to support work-life balance.

- Competitive Pay & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.



Deliverables

How Success is Measured in This Role:

In this role, success is defined by your ability to create powerful, visually engaging content that drives results and strengthens our brand. Here's what success looks like:

- Bring Still Images to Life: Use Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator to transform static images into dynamic, attention-grabbing animated ads.

- Video Editing & Motion Graphics: Take raw video footage and craft compelling narratives that speak to our audience. Combine video editing with motion graphics to produce engaging social media content and advertisements.

- Motion Graphics Design Expertise: Create stunning motion graphics that enhance video content, using your design skills to add visual appeal and depth to advertisements, social media posts, and promotional videos.

- Animate Static Assets: Transform still images and logos into dynamic animated visuals, elevating the storytelling experience and ensuring content stands out across multiple platforms.

- Graphic Design Mastery: Create visually compelling static graphics, including social media posts, website assets, and
 templates that align with our brand’s voice and aesthetic.

- Design Integration: Combine graphic design with video editing to create cohesive content, ensuring that all visual elements complement each other and enhance the storytelling experience.

- Adapt Content for Multiple Platforms: Re-edit video content into different aspect ratios for various platforms, ensuring optimal presentation and engagement.

- Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with the creative team and stakeholders to ensure your video content aligns with the brand strategy and meets project goals.

- Create Visual Masterpieces: Resize, cut out, and composite images to create eye-catching graphics that complement your video content.

- Maintain Quality: Ensure that all animations and video content are on-brand, visually appealing, and adhere to the highest standards.

- Meet Deadlines & Deliver on Expectations: Take ownership of project timelines and ensure your content is delivered on time, meeting or exceeding expectations.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

The BSI will work closely with internal leadership, implementation leads, and operational stakeholders to execute workflow automations, maintain integrations, support rollout initiatives, troubleshoot operational issues, and contribute to continuous process improvement efforts.

This role may enter during active systems integration, operational optimization, and platform transition initiatives involving tools such as QBO and JobTread. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working within evolving operational environments, adapting to ongoing implementation changes, and supporting execution during active rollout phases rather than only within fully established systems. This role is ideal for someone who is technically capable, operationally proactive, eager to grow within AI implementation and systems integration, and comfortable working in a collaborative and fast-moving environment. The position operates within an existing implementation and governance support structure, with guidance and escalation support already established internally for larger implementation, governance, and architectural requirements.

Responsibilities:

 • Publishing SEO content (blog posts, articles, service pages) to client websites

 • Optimizing and posting updates to Google Business Profiles (GBPs)

 • Managing citations and directory listings

Beyond execution, you’ll also:

mbers to ensure on-time delivery for clients

This role is a great fit for someone who wants to build real SEO expertise by getting hands-on with client accounts, with room to grow into more strategic responsibilities over time.



Job Details:

 • Time Commitment: 40-45 Hours / Week. We are only looking for a full time tea
mber that can commit fully to working with FirstCall Marketing.

 • Working Hours: Our business operates on US Mountain Standard Time, and the expectation for this role will most likely be to work MT hours. In some cases we may have flexibility to shift hours later depending on the person and the needs of the team, but candidates should apply expecting to work MT hours.

Characteristics Qualifications:



To fit with our team culture, you must align with our three core values: Competitive Greatness, Sincere Candor and Unimpeachable Character.



 1. Competitive Greatness: Bringing your best everyday. Being willing to go the extra mile. You enjoy a challenge and look to build your own skills along with driving value for the company.

I am excited to receive your application and meet you soon. Selamat Po!

title: Full-Time UGC Manager — Creator Acquisition & Management for Premium Skincare Brand (DTC/Ecommerce)
description:
About Us:



VEAUTY is a fast-growing premium skincare technology brand selling direct-to-consumer through our Shopify store. Our hero product, the VEAUTY Dot, is the world's only true home fractional RF device — used by 56,000+ customers and trusted by 150+ professional clinics worldwide. We're scaling our content engine aggressively and need a dedicated UGC Manager to build and manage a constant pipeline of creators producing authentic, high-converting content for our brand.



The Role:



We're looking for a full-time, dedicated UGC Manager who can find, recruit, negotiate with, and manage UGC creators at scale. Your job is to keep a steady stream of fresh, authentic video and photo content flowing into our creative team — content that our video editors will then turn into high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

This isn't a "post on social media" role. This is a sourcing, outreach, negotiation, and project management role. You'll be the bridge between creators and our brand — ensuring we always have new faces, new angles, and new content to fuel our advertising. You'll work closely with our marketing manager on scripts, creative direction, hooks, and content style to ensure every piece of UGC aligns with what's working in our ads.



What You'll Do:



You'll source and recruit new UGC creators on an ongoing basis — our preferred model is gifted partnerships (sending free product in exchange for content), though you'll also manage paid creators when needed. You'll build and maintain a pipeline of active creators so we never run dry on fresh content. You'll handle all communication with creators — outreach, onboarding, briefing, follow-ups, and feedback. You'll write and send detailed creator briefs that include scripts, hooks, visual direction, dos and don'ts, and example videos so creators know exactly what we need. You'll coordinate with our marketing manager to align all briefs with current ad strategy, winning hooks, and performance data. You'll manage delivery timelines and hold creators accountable — ensuring content arrives on time and meets our quality standards. You'll provide constructive feedback when content doesn't match the brief, and manage revision requests without burning creator relationships. You'll negotiate fair rates with paid creators, always balancing quality with budget efficiency. You'll track everything — creator contacts, outreach status, delivery dates, content received, and performance — in an organized system.



What We Need From You:



You must have 1+ years of experience sourcing and managing UGC creators or influencer partnerships for ecommerce or DTC brands. You need proven experience with gifted/seeding campaigns — convincing creators to produce content in exchange for free product is a core skill for this role. You should be comfortable with cold outreach via DM and
, with a track record of getting responses and building creator relationships.



You must be highly organized — managing 10–30+ active creators simultaneously requires tight systems, follow-up discipline, and attention to detail. You need strong written communication skills — your outreach messages, briefs, and follow-ups need to be clear, professional, and persuasive.



You should understand what makes great UGC for direct-response advertising — this isn't about pretty content, it's about authentic content that converts. You need to know the difference between content that looks good on a feed and content that stops the scroll in a paid ad. Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and the broader creator landscape is essential. Experience using platforms like Billo, Insense, JoinBrands, or similar UGC marketplaces is a plus. Experience in the skincare, beauty, or health/wellness niche is a strong advantage.



What Success Looks Like:



In your first month, you'll have sourced and onboarded your first batch of creators, established your outreach and tracking systems, and delivered your first round of UGC content to our editing team. By month two, you'll have a steady pipeline producing new content weekly, with a mix of gifted and paid creators. By month three, you'll be proactively identifying creator styles and content angles that align with our best-performing ads — bringing ideas to the table, not just filling orders.

Our best UGC managers don't just find creators — they build relationships, understand what content drives results, and become the engine that keeps our creative team fed with fresh material.



The Terms:



This is a full-time, exclusive role at $750 USD/month. You will not be permitted to work for any other brands or clients while employed with us — we need your full focus and commitment. This is a long-term position with room for growth, increased responsibility, and additional compensation as the brand scales.

Working hours: 8 hours/day, Monday–Friday (flexible on timezone, but consistent availability is required).

You must have a reliable computer and stable internet connection for full-time remote work.

3 Key Skills Required



Creator Sourcing & Outreach — ability to find, approach, and recruit UGC creators through DMs,
, platforms, and communities, with a focus on gifted/seeding partnerships.

Project Management & Organization — managing multiple creators simultaneously with tight deadlines, tracking systems, and consistent follow-through to ensure content is delivered on time and to standard.

Creative Briefing & Communication — writing clear, detailed briefs that translate marketing strategy into creator-friendly direction, and providing constructive feedback that improves content quality without damaging relationships.



How to Apply:



Complete our application form here: 



Your application must include a link to your portfolio, LinkedIn, or any proof of previous UGC management work (case studies, campaign results, creator databases). Applications without proof of experience will not be considered.



We will review all applications and only contact shortlisted candidates. Please do not follow up — if you're selected, you'll hear from us.

title: Client Onboarding & Communication Support
description:
We’re Not Hiring “Ad Experts.” We’re Hiring People Who Learn Fast and Execute Cleanly.

 

We’re hiring an Account Management Specialist to support our Account Managers and keep client onboarding, communication, and internal task updates moving smoothly. This role is responsible for making sure every onboarding step is completed, every client request is acknowledged, every Slack channel is monitored, every follow-up is handled on time, and every ClickUp task is updated properly.

Openings: 3

Core Skills and Requirements

Has a basic background or understanding of how Meta ads work

Has project management experience or has used project management tools before

Has strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Has a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Is open to feedback and treats it as an opportunity to improve

Is responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Can document actions, updates, and observations clearly and consistently

Knows when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Can help keep onboarding tasks, client requests, and internal updates organized



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You will not be expected to improvise or create your own system from scratch. You will be working inside a clear process and helping make sure that process is followed properly.

Support Account Managers during client onboarding

Ensure all onboarding requirements are completed fully and on time

Monitor client Slack channels daily for messages, questions, or follow-ups

Make sure client requests are acknowledged and routed correctly

Follow up on open items until they are resolved or completed

Flag risks, delays, missing information, or blockers early

Help keep onboarding and client communication organized

Make sure tasks are not left hanging without updates or next steps

You are not expected to manage client strategy. You are expected to keep the process tight, organized, and moving forward.



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, ownership, and quality of execution.

The role starts with a 90-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, and responsiveness, there will be room to discuss salary growth, especially if you are consistently adding value to the team and our clients.

We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.

Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for someone who can adapt, stay organized, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body of your application:

Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your account management, project management, onboarding, or client communication experience. To confirm availability, please close the recording by saying: “I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Marketing Strategist (digital experience)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a data-driven Marketing Strategist (Digital Experience) to lead the optimization of our online customer touchpoints. You will be responsible for crafting strategies that elevate the brand, increase organic traffic, and optimize digital experiences to drive lead generation and sales. By combining customer behavior insights with digital marketing best practices, you will ensure a seamless and personalized journey across all digital channels. 



Key Responsibilities

- Digital Experience & UX Strategy: Map and optimize the digital customer journey, ensuring a seamless, user-friendly experience across our website, landing pages, and mobile apps.

- Campaign Development: Design and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies across SEO/SEM, paid media (PPC),
, and social media. 

- Analytics & Optimization: Utilize web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics 4, Hotjar) to monitor site traffic, track conversion rates, and conduct A/B testing on digital assets to improve user flow and ROI.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Product, Web Development, Design, and Content teams to implement UX improvements and maintain brand consistency across all digital platforms. 

- Content & Personalization Strategy: Develop a robust content calendar and personalization strategy to ensure the right messaging reaches target audience segments at the right time.

- Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of the curve regarding digital marketing trends, UX/UI best practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI in marketing, algorithm updates).



Qualifications & Requirements 

- Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital strategy, or UX marketing, preferably in an agency or fast-paced in-house environment.

- Technical Skills:

Proficiency with digital marketing and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, SEO tools like SEMrush or Ahrefs).

Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and marketing automation (e.g., Marketo, Mailchimp).

Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Contentful) is a plus.

- Soft Skills: Excellent project management abilities, strong analytical thinking, and effective communication skills to present strategies to stakeholders.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) improvements

- Website bounce rates and average session duration

- Organic traffic growth and Search Engine Ranking

- Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

- Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and retention rates

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Edgewood Monuments is a growing U.S. monument company with multiple locations. We design, order, produce, ship, and install custom granite headstones and memorials.



# About the Position

Our orders involve exact dimensions, granite colors, finishes, accessories, customer information, suppliers, container shipments, inventory, and multiple internal systems. Small mistakes can cause expensive remakes or months of delay.



# Mission of the Role

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for keeping purchasing, container, inventory, and project information accurate across the company. Your primary mission is to catch errors before they become expensive problems, keep orders moving, and ensure that the correct information is entered and maintained in every system. This is not a basic data-entry position. You will be expected to verify information, investigate discrepancies, follow up with others, and take ownership of tasks through completion.



# Core Competencies

### Attention to Detail

- You consistently notice small differences in dimensions, quantities, colors, project numbers, pricing, and documentation.

Ownership

- You take responsibility for getting a task fully completed, not merely passing it to someone else.

Follow-Through

- You maintain an organized follow-up system and do not allow open tasks to disappear.



### Judgment

You know when information can be verified independently and when an issue must be escalated.



### Organization

You can manage multiple open orders, shipments, deadlines, and systems without losing track of details.



### Clear Communication

You communicate discrepancies and next steps concisely and professionally.



### Process Discipline

You follow checklists and established procedures consistently, even when performing repetitive work.



### Learning Ability

You can quickly learn new terminology, software, workflows, and company procedures.



# How to Apply

Please provide:

- Your résumé.

- Your expected hourly rate.

- Your availability in Pacific Time.

- A one-to-three-minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing a meaningful error you caught before it caused a problem.

- Rate your experience from 1–10 with:

     - Google Sheets

    - Trello

    - Odoo

    - Slack

    - QuickBooks

Role Overview

You will be responsible for:



Keeping QuickBooks Online clean and accurate (you'll work with out bookkeeper and mostly work through spreadsheets)

Reconciling our Jobber ? QBO data and AI exports

Preparing simple, reliable weekly and monthly reports so the owner can make decisions fast

Rough time expectation: 10–15 hours/week, with room to grow as we grow.



Responsibilities

Weekly



Review AI / Jobber exports (jobs, revenue, services) into Google Sheets

Check for errors, missing data, or obvious anomalies and correct them

Update a simple Weekly Performance Sheet:

Jobs completed

Revenue by product line

COGS (from QBO)

Ad spend by channel (Google Ads, LSA, Meta – we will provide numbers)

Net after ads

Monthly



Ensure Jobber invoices / payments are correctly mapped for our bookkeeper to QBO products & income accounts

Prepare the payroll summary (hours, OT, tips, commissions) in our template for our payroll provider weekly

Requirements

3+ years bookkeeping experience for US-based businesses

Strong QuickBooks Online skills (certification preferred)

Experience with at least one field-service or job management tool (Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, etc. – Jobber is a big plus)

Comfortable reading and cleaning exports in Google Sheets

 / message with subject line:

title: Accounting Operations Specialist – U.S. Accounting Firm
description:
Remote | U.S.-Based Accounting & Business Advisory Firm



About Atlanta Business Services



Atlanta Business Services is a growing U.S.-based accounting and business advisory firm that provides accounting, bookkeeping, financial insights, and business support services to growing companies.



We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Operations Specialist to support our accounting team.



This is a hands-on accounting and operations role for someone who enjoys bookkeeping, working with structured processes, documenting information, and helping a team stay organized.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working behind the scenes while also attending designated client meetings to document important information, decisions, and follow-up items.



This is not a sales position or financial advisory position.



Position Purpose



The Accounting Operations Specialist supports our Client Account Specialists by completing recurring bookkeeping and accounting production tasks, maintaining accurate client documentation, assisting with client spreadsheets, and helping ensure Atlanta Business Services' Standard Operating Procedures are properly documented and maintained.



A major responsibility of this role is helping information move efficiently from:



Client Conversation ? Documentation ? Task Assignment ? Follow-Up ? Completion



The Accounting Operations Specialist helps ensure important client information, accounting questions, and follow-up items do not get lost.



Primary Responsibilities

Accounting & Bookkeeping Production

Categorize and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts.

Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable bookkeeping.

Record payroll journal entries using established procedures.

Review uncategorized transactions and identify items requiring clarification.

Complete assigned month-end close checklist tasks.

Maintain supporting accounting documentation.

Identify bookkeeping discrepancies and escalate questions to the assigned Client Account Specialist.

Assist with recurring accounting schedules and client reporting support.

Follow written SOPs, checklists, and video instructions.

Complete assigned tasks by established deadlines.

Document work completed and communicate unresolved accounting items.

Client Meeting Documentation & Follow-Up

Attend designated client meetings with Client Account Specialists and other Atlanta Business Services tea
mbers.

Listen carefully and document important client discussions.

Prepare clear and organized meeting notes.

Enter meeting notes into the firm's practice management software.

Document client decisions, requests, and accounting information discussed during meetings.

Identify action items and follow-up responsibilities.

Create or update tasks in the practice management software based on meeting discussions.

Assign or route follow-up items to the appropriate tea
mber according to established procedures.

Document due dates and follow-up deadlines.

Maintain an accurate record of unresolved client questions.

Flag accounting or client issues requiring Client Account Specialist review.

Assist the team with tracking outstanding client documents and information.



The Accounting Operations Specialist is not responsible for independently providing accounting advice or financial recommendations during client meetings.



Technical accounting questions should be documented and escalated to the appropriate Client Account Specialist.



Standard Operating Procedure Documentation & Maintenance

Assist with creating written Standard Operating Procedures from team instructions and training videos.

Review Loom videos and convert processes into organized written SOPs.

Format SOPs using Atlanta Business Services' approved SOP template.

Document the purpose, frequency, responsible role, required systems, and steps for each process.

Include appropriate escalation procedures within SOPs.

Maintain the firm's SOP library.

Review SOPs for outdated information.

Update SOPs when approved processes change.

Maintain SOP creation and revision dates.

Identify recurring processes that do not have documented SOPs.

Notify the appropriate process owner when an SOP may need to be created or updated.

Ensure SOP documents are properly named, organized, and stored.



The Accounting Operations Specialist does not independently change Atlanta Business Services' accounting or operational procedures.



Process changes must be approved by the appropriate process owner or management tea
mber before the SOP is updated.



Excel & Client Spreadsheet Support

Perform accurate data entry into client Excel spreadsheets.

Maintain recurring client spreadsheets and accounting schedules.

Transfer financial and operational data between approved systems and spreadsheets.

Review spreadsheets for missing or duplicate information.

Sort and filter data.

Perform basic spreadsheet reconciliations.

Use basic and intermediate Excel formulas as needed.

Assist with maintaining client tracking spreadsheets.

Compare spreadsheet totals to accounting system reports when required.

Identify differences and escalate discrepancies to the Client Account Specialist.

Maintain accuracy and consistency when entering high volumes of financial data.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of bookkeeping or accounting support experience.

Strong QuickBooks Online experience.

Experience completing bank and credit card reconciliations.

Strong understanding of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles.

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms strongly preferred.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong English listening comprehension.

Ability to understand accounting terminology used during client conversations.

Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience working with spreadsheets and performing detailed data entry.

Strong attention to detail.

Experience following written SOPs, checklists, and video instructions.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Ability to manage multiple client assignments and deadlines.

Comfortable attending virtual client meetings.

Comfortable taking detailed meeting notes.

Ability to work independently and communicate when clarification is needed.

Reliable internet connection and professional remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working for a U.S. accounting or bookkeeping firm.

Experience supporting multiple accounting clients simultaneously.

Experience using accounting practice management software.

Experience creating or maintaining Standard Operating Procedures.

Experience converting training videos or Loom recordings into written SOPs.

Experience using task or project management software.

Experience maintaining client accounting schedules.

Experience with payroll journal entries.

Experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

The Ideal Candidate



You are organized, dependable, and comfortable working within structured processes.



You enjoy accounting and bookkeeping work but also understand the importance of strong documentation and follow-up.



You listen carefully.



You take detailed notes.



You notice when information is missing.



You do not guess when you are unsure.



You ask clear and organized questions.



You understand the difference between completing a task and independently changing a process.



You are comfortable receiving instructions through written SOPs, checklists, and training videos.



You understand that completing accounting work accurately is more important than simply completing tasks quickly.



You enjoy helping a team stay organized and making sure important information does not get lost.



This Position Does Not Require

Sales.

Business development.

Financial advisory services.

Fractional CFO analysis.

Independent client financial recommendations.

Leading client relationship management.

Final financial statement review.

Independently changing accounting policies or firm procedures.

Schedule



This is a remote position.



Full-time or part-time opportunities may be considered based on experience and availability.



Regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required to attend designated client meetings and communicate with the Atlanta Business Services team.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



A brief description of your bookkeeping and accounting experience.

The number of years you have used QuickBooks Online.

A description of your experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms.

A description of your Excel experience.

A description of any experience creating or maintaining SOPs.

A description of your experience attending virtual client meetings or documenting meeting notes.

Your current work availability.

The U.S. Eastern Time hours you are available to work.

Your desired hourly or monthly compensation.

A link to a video answering the screening questions below.



Applications that do not follow all instructions may not be considered.



Video Screening Questions



Please record a video of no more than 5 minutes answering the following questions:



Question 1



A bank reconciliation does not balance. Explain how you would investigate the difference before asking your supervisor for help.



Question 2



You attend a client meeting and the client mentions five different accounting issues, agrees to send two documents, and asks for a report by Friday.



Explain what you would do immediately after the meeting to ensure nothing is missed.



Question 3



You are following a written SOP, but the QuickBooks file does not match the process shown in the SOP.



Explain how you would handle the situation.



We are evaluating your accounting knowledge, English communication, organization, judgment, and ability to follow established processes.

title: Remote MSP Systems Engineer — Microsoft 365 & Windows Server (L2/L3)
description:
We're a US-based managed services provider (MSP) supporting small and mid-sized businesses. We're hiring an experienced systems engineer to handle escalated support and project execution remotely — Microsoft 365, Windows Server, identity/security, and automation. You'll work from documented runbooks and our ticketing system, and you'll have senior US staff to escalate genuinely complex design questions to. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who is reliable, self-directed, and communicates clearly in English with clients.



What you'll do

- Administer Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online — mailboxes, distribution lists, quarantine/spam policy, shared mailboxes, licensing

- Support Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and RDS — troubleshooting, performance, user management

- Write and maintain PowerShell scripts and RMM automations (custom scripts, monitoring conditions, remediation)

- Execute client onboarding from our documented checklists (EDR, SIEM, patching, backups, security baselines)

- Handle identity security i
 at the triage level (review sign-ins, reset credentials/MFA, remove malicious rules) following our playbook

- Configure and troubleshoot networking — site-to-site VPN tunnels, firewalls, UniFi

- Document your work thoroughly and keep client documentation current



Required

- 4+ years in MSP or IT support (L2/L3)

- Strong Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online administration

- Solid Windows Server — AD, GPO, DNS/DHCP, RDS

- PowerShell scripting — you write and modify scripts, not just run them

- Networking fundamentals — VPN, firewall rules, VLANs, DNS

- Excellent written and spoken English — you'll communicate directly with US clients

- Reliable internet, a quiet work environment, and the discipline to work independently from documentation



Nice to have

- Experience with NinjaOne (RMM), ConnectWise (PSA), Veeam

- Entra Conditional Access design experience

- Microsoft certifications (MS-102, AZ-104, or similar)



How we work

You'll connect through a company-provided secure environment to access our systems — we'll set you up and train you on our tools and runbooks. We value people who flag what they don't know and ask before guessing.



To apply

Start your message with the word "BACKUP" so we know you read this far. Then tell us: (1) your years of MSP experience, (2) a short example of a PowerShell script or automation you built and what problem it solved, and (3) your available hours in US Eastern time. Applications without the code word won't be reviewed.
