title: Video Editor
description:
We are a company in the social media and digital content industry looking for a talented and creative Video Editor VA to join our remote team. This is a part-time position working on Central Standard Time (CST) hours. If you have a passion for short-form video content and a strong eye for what makes viewers stop scrolling, we want to hear from you.



We are looking for someone who understands the rhythm and energy of Instagram Reels, keeps up with current trends, and can consistently deliver polished, high-quality edits from raw footage.





POSITION OVERVIEW



Your primary responsibility will be editing raw footage into engaging 30 to 60-second Instagram Reels that capture attention and hold it. You will work closely with our team to maintain a consistent visual style and deliver content that performs well on social media.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit raw footage into polished, attention-grabbing Instagram Reels that are 30 to 60 seconds long

- Add captions, transitions, music, sound effects, and motion graphics where appropriate

- Maintain a consistent editing style that aligns with our brand identity

- Deliver high-quality edits within established turnaround deadlines

- Organize project files, revisions, and assets in an efficient and accessible manner

- Stay current with Instagram Reels trends, short-form video best practices, and platform updates

- Incorporate feedback and revisions professionally and promptly





QUALIFICATIONS



Required:



- Proven experience editing short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or a comparable editing software

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, and viewer retention techniques

- Excellent attention to detail and a good eye for visual consistency

- Reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines consistently

- A strong portfolio showcasing short-form video editing work is required to be considered



Preferred:



- Prior experience editing content for creators, brands, or businesses

- Familiarity with basic motion graphics and animated captions

- Experience using AI-assisted editing tools such as OpusClip, Descript, or Captions

- Basic knowledge of social media content strategy and platform-specific best practices





POSITION DETAILS



- Type: Part-Time

- Setup: Remote (Work from Home)

- Schedule: Central Standard Time (CST)





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this role, please submit all of the following:



- Updated Resume

- Updated Portfolio



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Accountant
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Senior Accounts Payable Accountant



Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 AM EST, with a 1-hour break



Salary: $1,400 per month



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant with extensive Accounts Payable (AP) and Travel & Expense (T&E) management experience, ready to apply their knowledge and expertise in a hands-on, high-impact role and make it their own. Reporting directly to the Controller & Head of Finance, this role offers broad exposure, real ownership of the AP and expense management process, and close collaboration with Accounting, Finance, and Operations leadership.



The ideal candidate is willing to own the AP and T&E process from end to end, is comfortable partnering with non-finance teams and explaining the "why" behind processes, and is eager to take on visibility, responsibility, and the opportunity to help build scalable financial processes while supporting month-end activities, vendor payments, expense workflows, and process improvements.



This role requires someone who can independently manage high-volume AP operations, oversee the AP and T&E workflows, and require minimal day-to-day guidance while helping improve the overall AP function.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Payable & Expense Management



Own the end-to-end AP process, including vendor onboarding, invoice coding, approvals, and payment execution.

Manage corporate card and employee expense workflows using Ramp.

Manage the AP and T&E inboxes, ensuring accurate and timely processing of high-volume invoices, vendor requests, employee expenses, and payment workflows.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies while maintaining strong documentation and controls.



General Ledger & Close



Participate in closing AP at month-end.

Assist with identifying month-end accruals.

Perform balance sheet reconciliations (AP, credit cards payable, etc.).

Maintain accurate financial records in NetSuite and/or Xero.



Audit, Controls & Compliance



Support external audits, audit requests, and walkthroughs, as needed.

Partner with the Head of Fin & Acctg Mgr to strengthen internal controls as the company scales



Media & Production Cost Accounting



Collaborate with production, editorial, and operations teams to ensure accurate AP coding and vendor information gathering, cost tracking, and reconciling trackers to the general ledger.

Develop an understanding of media-specific accounting areas such as production costs, talent payments, and deal-related expenses



Process Improvement & Systems & Lead Ramp / T&E Trainings



Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency using systems, Excel, and policy documentation.

Contribute to system optimization across AP and expense management tools.

Lead onboarding and training sessions for managers and new employees related to Ramp, T&E reconciliation expectations, receipt collection requirements, and expense submission best practices.

Educate non-finance teams on expense coding structure and departmental coding expectations to improve financial reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and spend visibility.

Partner cross-functionally to reinforce timely reconciliations, proper documentation standards, and consistent coding practices across the organization.



Required Skills & Qualifications:



5+ years of progressive Accounts Payable experience, including managing high-volume AP operations.

Hands-on experience managing Travel & Expense (T&E), vendor management, and month-end close support.

Ability to independently manage AP workflows with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Experience with or exposure to accounting systems such as NetSuite, Xero, Ramp, or similar.

Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and take ownership in a lean environment.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

Experience working in media, technology, or high-growth companies.

Experience in a startup or fast-scaling organization.

Previous experience as a Senior AP Accountant, AP Lead, or AP Manager is highly preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant (PHP 50,000 per month)
description:
Salary: PHP 50,000 per month

Location: Remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire





About HiveRef



HiveRef is a fast-growing SaaS company helping businesses hire smarter through structured, professional reference checking. We work with clients trading across Australia, Europe, the USA, and Asia, and we're scaling quickly. This is your chance to join a growing international team and play a genuine role in how our clients build their workforces.





The Role



We're looking for an experienced Senior Recruitment & Sourcing Consultant to source and identify strong candidates on behalf of our clients, businesses based in Australia, Europe, the USA, and across Asia. You'll be working across different markets and industries, so no two days will look the same.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the hunt: finding the right person for the right role, building genuine talent pipelines, and understanding what makes a candidate a strong fit, not just a resume that ticks boxes.





What You'll Be Doing



= Sourcing and identifying qualified candidates for open roles across our client base in Australia, Europe, the USA, and Asia

= Building and maintaining talent pipelines across a range of industries and role types

= Screening candidates for fit, experience, and communication skills before shortlisting

= Coordinating with clients to understand role requirements and hiring priorities

= Using job boards, LinkedIn, and other sourcing platforms to find both active and passive candidates

= Keeping candidate records and pipeline status organised and up to date







What We're Looking For



= Proven experience in recruitment and candidate sourcing, ideally across international markets

= Strong understanding of how to source for roles in Australia, Europe, the USA, or Asia specifically

= Confident using LinkedIn, job boards, and sourcing tools to find quality candidates

= Excellent spoken and written English communication skills

= Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple client pipelines at once

= Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote role

= Experience working with international clients or in a BPO/outsourced recruitment setting is a strong advantage







How to Apply



We want to understand your recruitment background properly, not just see a job title. In your application, please include:



= A full resume that clearly outlines your recruitment and sourcing experience, including the companies or clients you've worked with.



Details of your sourcing experience, including:



= Which markets you've recruited for (Australia, Europe, USA, Asia, or elsewhere)

= What types of roles and industries you've sourced for

= Which tools and platforms you've used (LinkedIn, job boards, ATS systems, etc.)

= Any results you can share (roles filled, time-to-hire, pipeline size)



A short note on why international recruitment interests you, and what you're looking for in your next role.



If you've got genuine sourcing experience and enjoy the challenge of finding the right person for the right role, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply today and dont miss out on this opportunity.



Hiveref is part of a network of recruitment companies.

title: Real Estate Sales Rep (Part-Time / Immediate Start)
description:
Duration: 1-Week Trial (with long-term potential based on performance) | Start Date: IMMEDIATE



We are seeking a reliable, fluent English speaker for a quick, 1-week part-time trial project starting immediately. This is a very simple, low-stress position. You do not need to do any data entry, you do not need access to our CRM, and you do not need to do any hard selling. The dialer does all the heavy lifting, you just sit on the line, wait for someone to answer, and read a short script.



How to Apply: Send a brief voice recording (Vocaroo link) introducing yourself. Applications without voice notes will NOT be considered.



Key Responsibilities:



- Work a 4-hour shift from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST (Monday - Friday).

- Log into our automated phone dialer (it rings automatically, you just wait for a pickup).

- Read a short, friendly script to see if the person on the phone is buying residential properties.

- If they say yes, just write down the name of the person and the time of the call on a simple list for the owner.

- That’s it! No inputting data, no system management. The owner will pull the call recordings in the morning.



Requirements:



- Flawless, articulate English communication skills with a highly professional corporate tone.

- Proven experience in US real estate lead generation, corporate outreach, or market research is highly preferred.

- Premium hardware setup: High-speed stable internet, dedicated quiet workspace, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Availability for a 1-hour onboarding and orientation session in the morning (Manila time).

- Highly resilient professional mindset with the ability to maintain consistent output.



Performance & Expectations:

Please note that while the task is simple, this is a results-driven position. We track call data, connection rates, and lead quality daily. We are looking for an action-taker who can successfully pre-qualify buyers using the script. Keeping the shift past the first 48 hours is strictly based on your daily performance and your ability to bring in verified buyer names.
